title: Show placeholder hint for stored API key and trim parsed apiKey
body: ### Motivation - Users can misread an empty API key input as "not configured" even when a server-side key exists, so provide a clear, safe visual cue while keeping the existing save semantics. - Ensure stored/masked API keys returned from the backend are treated as presence indicators without accidentally being written back to the server. ### Description - Populate `LlmConfig.apiKey` from the backend response (trimmed) in `_fromMap`. The masked server value (e.g. `****ABCD`) serves as the presence indicator — `apiKey.isNotEmpty` is used to drive the hint. The save path remains safe because the UI always passes `_apiKeyController.text.trim()` (empty unless the user types a new key) when calling `save()`, so the masked value is never written back. - Render a one-line parenthesized hint in the API key `TextFormField` when `apiKey.isNotEmpty`, and preserve the existing helper text `"Leave blank to keep your existing key"` and blank input semantics. - Apply a subtle `hintStyle` using `Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.color` when the hint is shown so it visually matches disabled/secondary text. - Extract the hint string `'(已设置，出于安全原因未显示)'` to a top-level `kApiKeyStoredHint` constant in `model_settings_screen.dart`, referenced by both the widget and the tests to avoid duplication and copy drift. - Update widget tests: fixture uses `apiKey: '****ABCD'`, references `kApiKeyStoredHint` constant, and the `shows API key placeholder hint for stored key` test is placed in its own `ModelSettingsScreen – API key hint` group. ### Testing - Ran `flutter test test/model_settings_screen_test.dart` — all 8 tests (including `shows API key placeholder hint for stored key`) passed. - Existing delete/save flow widget tests continued to pass after the changes. ------ Codex Task
